title: Holiday Cookie Batch: Three Doughs, One Oven
servesOrScale: three doughs, roughly a hundred cookies
constraints: two sheet pans that must cool between batches
notes: The oven is a queue and so are the pans: each bake waits on the previous bake AND on a cooled pan, which is why the gingerbread bake carries a three-way compound trigger. temper-sugar-dough is inferred: the text says to roll dough that has been in the refrigerator for an hour but never says to let it come back to room temperature, so the step borrows the rolling sentence as its span.
